decisive_items: intraepidermal neoplasm consisting of pagetoid cells
Incisional biopsy revealed an intraepidermal neoplasm consisting of pagetoid cells
response.rationale: Only one candidate was supplied; its raw support spans directly match the histopathologic and immunohistochemical findings (pagetoid cells, CK7/EMA positivity) characteristic of extramammary Paget's disease. No competing candidate exists for comparison.
